text: A digital art depicts a woman in military uniform with a white peaked hat, red-trimmed collar, and draped red cloak, featuring text reading "XING-ART.DEVIANTART.COM" and "https://www.deviantart.com/xing-art", set against a dark background with a glowing red skull under dramatic backlighting, rendered in a palette of crimson, black, gold, and white, digital painting, fantasy art, character illustration

A digital art of a person near a large creature in a forest, set against a dark woodland background with tall vertical tree trunks and scattered ambient specks, rendered in a muted palette dominated by deep blues, blacks, and dark browns contrasted by vibrant turquoise and emerald green, illuminated by a glowing cyan outline emanating from the creature and a soft green ground glow underneath, captured from an eye-level angle, pixel art, retro gaming style

A digital art depicts a man in a white collared shirt holding a bright orange acoustic guitar, surrounded by numerous potted green plants and flowers. The indoor setting features textured walls and columns framing the central subject. The color palette is dominated by rich shades of emerald green, deep forest green, and vibrant orange accents. The lighting is even and flat, reminiscent of mid-century modernist painting styles. The composition is captured from a straight-on perspective with bold graphic contours, woodcut style, gouache texture

An oil painting of an older man with gray hair against a dark blue background. The man wears a light gray three-piece suit with a white collared shirt and a blue tie, and holds a crumpled gray cloth in one hand. The artist's signature and date appear in the bottom left corner as "Chas. Locku -1995" The color palette consists of cool grays, deep blues, and dark neutral tones. The lighting illuminates the man's face and upper body while the background remains in deep shadow, impressionism, impasto brushwork, textured canvas

A cartoon depicts an elderly woman in a straw hat and dark red shawl eating bread outdoors against a grassy hillside landscape under bright natural daylight with an eye-level angle, anime style, cel shading, hand-drawn animation

A stained glass depicts a woman adorned with a crown and holding a spoked wheel, with a sword positioned below her, featuring the inscription "S:TA CA:TERINA", set against a dark architectural framework filled with vertical leaded panels of red, green, blue, and gold glass, illuminated by bright daylight passing through the translucent window panes, stained glass, medieval art, tracery

A digital art depicts a lone cowboy in a dimly lit rustic interior setting filled with rustic clutter, a broom, and a glowing window backdrop. The color palette consists of muted earth tones, browns, and deep shadows, illuminated by warm, directional backlighting from the window. The composition utilizes a low-angle perspective, emphasizing the atmospheric mood and detailed textures of the room, digital painting, impressionism, concept art

A cartoon depicts an anthropomorphic female mouse character holding a glowing crystal, positioned above a burning city viewed from a low-angle perspective, with two darkened hands reaching upward from the bottom foreground. The background features architectural structures resembling a castle and city buildings consumed by fire and embers. The color palette is dominated by intense pinks, magentas, reds, and warm oranges, creating a fiery atmosphere. The scene is lit from above by the glowing crystal and from below by the raging fires, casting a bright, dramatic glow on the floating character while silhouetting the hands below, digital illustration, vibrant lighting

A cartoon depicts a woman with red hair in a blue bow, wearing a white striped top, a blue skirt, dark leggings, and light blue shoes, next to a small white chicken with a red comb, set against a muted green textured background with a white outlined border, featuring the text "ADX2K" in the bottom right corner, illuminated by bright, flat lighting with a slight paper-grain texture visible throughout the illustration, retro animation, cel shading, graphic design

A digital art depicts a character with short silver hair and a blindfold, wearing armored pauldrons and an intricate dress, holding a smiling round mask in her hands. Two swords are strapped behind her, one broad and one katana. Two vertical pillars flanking her bear the inscriptions "ПАТРУЛЬ" and "КЛОП" in Cyrillic letters. The background shows an arched stone chamber wall. The color palette is dominated by muted, sickly greenish-yellow tones blended with dark charcoals and grays, creating a heavy, monochromatic oil-painting texture. The lighting is dim and diffused with highlights on the upper torso and mask, under a straight-on eye-level angle, digital painting, impasto texture, dark fantasy

A stained glass depicts a haloed man in dark clerical robes holding a crucifix, set against an ornate, leaf-patterned backdrop with white and gold floral motifs. Inscribed near the bottom is "S. FRANCIS XAVIER". The palette relies on deep blacks, rich blues, and warm gold tones, illuminated from behind to highlight the translucent glass texture. The low-angle perspective emphasizes the verticality of the window frame, stained glass, ecclesiastical art, tracery

A ukiyo-e depicts a person adorned in ornate, patterned robes featuring floral and geometric motifs. Inscribed near the left edge is the text "松浦甚太郎". The setting incorporates a decorative folding screen in the background, embellished with painted plum blossoms, bamboo clusters, and golden clouds. The color palette relies on soft earth tones, including muted yellows, pale oranges, blacks, and subtle touches of red against a light paper background under even, flat illumination captured from an eye-level angle, woodblock print, hand-colored

A digital art depicts a lone traveler in a dark coat and red hood, bearing an illuminated circular emblem on the back, standing on a rock amidst a desolate, mountainous landscape beneath a gloomy, overcast sky, where vertical beams of pale pink light pierce through rolling clouds in the background, complemented by a muted color palette of grays, browns, and earthy tones with dramatic highlights on the mist and jagged rock formations under an atmospheric, high-angle view, digital painting, impasto brushwork, sci-fi concept art

A ukiyo-e depicts a woman wearing a plaid haori coat over a patterned kimono with ginger motifs, standing near a wooden architectural railing under a tiled roof. Inscribed text in the upper right reads "春信画" and "中村歌の", and vertical script in the lower right reads "芦月堂正名 奧村文甫政信正筆". The muted color palette consists of soft browns, blacks, and subtle flesh tones, illuminated by flat lighting. Shot from a straight-on eye-level angle, woodblock print, hand-colored

A digital art of a lone traveler with a canine companion beside a tall, weathered post bearing the vertical inscription "LIFESPEAR" in a vast, desolate, and foggy wasteland under a pale overcast sky. The color palette is dominated by muted grays and whites, punctuated by vibrant patches of yellow grass and a glowing light source illuminating a pool near the base of the post, creating a striking contrast against the dreary environment. The lighting is soft and diffused through the heavy fog, with focal illumination emanating from the glowing ground and the top of the post. The wide-angle lens perspective emphasizes the immense emptiness of the landscape, digital painting, sci-fi concept art

A ukiyo-e depicts a person holding an umbrella adorned with geometric patterns, wearing patterned robes featuring crests, and standing beneath flowering plum branches against a plain background. The monochrome woodblock print utilizes stark black and white contrasts with linear hatching and textured ink washes. The legible text reads "竹村千代" and "喜多川".

woodblock print, sumizuri-e, monochrome

A ukiyo-e depicts a man holding a fan and a woman carrying a burden on a yoke against a plain background rendered in monochrome tones with stark lighting under an eye-level angle, featuring visible text including "やきうた", Japanese woodblock print, Edo period

An oil painting depicts an interior scene with a heavy patterned tapestry draped in the foreground left, a painter on the right working at an easel, and a woman holding a book and trumpet in the background near a large map on the wall. The wall map features legible inscription text across the top reading "NOVA TOTIUS TERRARUM ORBIS GEOGRAPHICA AC HYDROGRAPHICA TABULA". The room features a black-and-white checkered floor, a golden chandelier hanging from a beamed ceiling, and warm natural light entering from the left. The color palette incorporates rich blues, reds, blacks, and golds with strong chiaroscuro lighting effects, Baroque, trompe-l'œil, oil paint texture

A stained glass depicts a scene inside a bedchamber featuring a canopied bed with draped white fabric against a deep blue background with swirling patterns. The color palette includes vibrant reds, blues, greens, golds, and whites. The work is backlit by ambient light filtering through the colored glass. At the bottom runs the inscription "CATIRIM SOLVITZW LINS NONRIIVT", Gothic art, stained glass window, roundel

A ukiyo-e depicts a woman and a samurai beside a wooden fence beneath flowering cherry trees, with the inscription "春章画". The muted color palette consists primarily of black, peach, and muted grey tones, highlighted by natural daylight illuminating the outdoor scene, woodblock print, ink on paper

A cartoon depicts a high-angle view of two children suspended in midair above a sprawling industrial canyon town, grasping onto a splintered wooden trestle structure. The background features dense canyon walls embedded with cluttered multi-story buildings, dark metal roofs, and thin brick smokestacks. The color palette consists of muted earthy browns, dark grays, and slate blues, illuminated by soft daylight casting gentle shadows across the wooden beams and cityscape, anime, cel shading

A cartoon of a woman with short brown hair wearing a green hooded jacket over a grey t-shirt with the text "ECKO UN", blue jeans, and black shoes in front of a blue background, and the same woman with braided hair wearing brown leather armor with blue light accents, fur trimming, brown boots, and holding a sword in front of an orange and red gradient background with the signature text "5/9/22" and "Aly" in the upper right corner, featuring flat cel shading, comic art, character design

A digital art depicts Mabel, Dipper, and Waddles the pig in a dark forest, with the "MYSTERY SHACK" building in the background. Dipper holds journal "3", and Mabel holds a grappling hook. A gnome is visible in the lower left corner. The color palette is dominated by deep purples, magentas, and browns. Backlit illumination casts a warm orange glow on the characters from the right, contrasting with cool purple shadows and glowing particles floating through the air. The scene is captured at eye-level with a soft-focus lens, impressionism, digital painting, fantasy art

A ukiyo-e depicts an indoor scene with blossoming cherry branches near a shoji screen structure holding a kettle and bowls. The color palette relies on subdued tones of tan, charcoal black, and muted pink across the patterned garments, set in flat lighting from a high-angle perspective, woodblock print, hand-colored

A cartoon depicts a stylized character with glowing white eyes and spiky black hair against a dark background, featuring the red graffiti text "GORILLAZ" overhead. The scene is illuminated by dramatic backlighting with purple and blue light beams radiating outward in a low-angle perspective. The color palette consists of deep indigos, dark purples, vibrant reds, and bright yellow accents on the clothing. The character wears oversized sneakers and dark trousers, placed centrally in a shadowy alleyway setting, digital illustration, cel shading, graphic design

A stained glass depicts a woman in a blue and pink robe adorned with white floral garments, centered below two men in elaborate robes holding a crown, surrounded by winged cherubs on clouds against a blue sky, beneath gothic archways with intricate stonework, illuminated by vibrant backlighting in rich jewel tones of red, purple, blue, and gold with strong black lead lines defining the illustrative shapes, stained glass, Christian art, religious iconography

An oil painting depicts an angel in a yellow garment and red sash appearing to an elderly man with a turban holding a knife over a youth lying beneath him on rocks, set against a dark, rugged landscape under a dramatic, stormy sky dominated by earthy browns, golds, and deep shadows with high-contrast chiaroscuro lighting, Rembrandt, Baroque, impasto

An oil painting depicts a mythological landscape set within an ornate golden oval frame, featuring a classical architectural building in the middle ground, rolling hills, and lush trees under a blue sky with white clouds. A woman wearing a flowing blue garment holding an arrow stands next to a man draped in blue and gold fabrics resting near a rock, while a winged angel with a bow floats in the air above them. In the background left, putti pull a small chariot near the water. The color palette blends deep greens, earthy browns, and soft blues under even lighting, Baroque, oil on canvas, framed art

A stained glass depicts two figures representing Jesus, with an angelic being above, rendered in a gothic architectural setting with rich blue, red, gold, and white hues illuminated by soft interior light from an eye-level perspective, featuring inscribed text at the base reading "To the glory of God and in loving memory of Richard John and Fanny Sankey erected by their surviving children", tracery, lancet window

A stained glass depicts a central bearded man with a halo, wearing a red robe over white garments, positioned in front of an architectural archway background with vertical columns and a decorative frieze. The composition is illuminated by a warm, backlit glow that shines through the richly colored glass pieces. The palette is dominated by deep reds, blues, oranges, and earthy browns, accented by white and dark tones in the clothing and hair. Numerous individuals with varied facial features and head coverings are arranged around the central man in the lower and upper sections. The lighting technique makes the translucent glass panels appear vibrant and luminous against the dark framing elements, stained glass, Gothic art, colored light

A stained glass depicts three arched window panels featuring biblical scenes in rich reds, blues, and golds beneath ornate architectural tracery. The glowing artwork is backlit, illuminating intricate details across the figures and patterned borders. The bottom panels feature legible inscriptions: "Clemens dabo vobis faciem vestram in terra...", "Dignus es Domine et in regno suo per Israel...", and "Benedicite domini omnes electi dei laudate sanctos..."

Gothic, stained glass, clerestory

A stained glass depicts an Annunciation scene divided by a stone mullion into two main vertical lancets filled with diamond quarry panes against a clear daylight background. The left panel shows an angel in red and pink robes with green-tinged wings and a shield below featuring a red diagonal band. The right panel shows the Virgin Mary in a blue robe and pink mantle beneath a blue-robed figure with red wings, alongside a lower shield bearing blue chevrons and flowers on a white field. Additional winged figures and golden scrolling foliage fill the upper and lower registers. The palette is rich with crimson, cobalt blue, gold, and white under bright backlighting, Gothic Revival style, leaded glass, artisanal craft
